title: Specialty Pharmacy Program Assistance Bulletin: Maximizer Benefit Available by Program Year
content:
Under the Specialty Pharmacy Program, a maximizer program year runs from January 1 to December 31 of the program year named on its benefit load.

**Rule.**

- When the latest shipped fill shipped within the program year of the latest maximizer benefit load, the benefit available before retail use is that load less the program draws taken off it.
- When the fill shipped after that program year ended, the benefit available before retail use is zero, because the new program year's benefit has not been loaded.
- Otherwise it is the assistance balance shown on the enrollment. This covers an enrollment with no load on its ledger, and a fill shipped before the load's program year.

The benefit a maximizer program draw draws on is the benefit available worked out under this rule. The assistance balance shown on the enrollment serves only in the last case.

## Terms

- **Latest maximizer benefit load.** The benefit load entry with the latest entry date on the enrollment's ledger. Its amount is the year's benefit as loaded, and its program year sets the January 1 to December 31 span.
- **Latest shipped fill.** The enrollment's shipped fill with the latest ship date. Its ship date is compared with that span.

## Ladder

| Ship date of the latest shipped fill | Benefit available before retail use |
|---|---|
| Within January 1 to December 31 of the latest load's program year, both days included | the load amount less the program draws taken off it |
| After December 31 of that year | zero |
| Before January 1 of that year, or no load on the ledger | the assistance balance shown on the enrollment |

## Cases (assumed: latest load for program year 2026 of $12,000.00, with $4,500.00 of program draws taken off it; assistance balance shown of $8,100.00)

- *Fill shipped 2026-06-15.* The benefit available before retail use is $7,500.00.
- *Fill shipped 2026-12-31.* The benefit available is still $7,500.00, since December 31 is inside the program year.
- *Fill shipped 2027-01-04.* The benefit available is $0.00, since the 2027 benefit has not been loaded.
- *No load on the ledger.* The benefit available is the $8,100.00 shown on the enrollment.
